description: Master executed rmapi push directly without routing to Rigby. No skill or documented convention existed for reMarkable document delivery — Master should have recognized this as a capability gap and routed to Rigby to define and codify the pattern before executing. Instead, Master improvised: pushed to wrong path (/) with wrong filename convention. Two errors resulted that required correction.
what_was_wrong: Master used rmapi directly without a skill, without checking for a naming convention, and without routing the capability build to Rigby. Pre-Write Gate logic applies to capability execution patterns, not just file writes.
correct_answer: Any time Master is about to use a tool (rmapi, osascript, etc.) for a delivery action with no existing skill or documented convention, stop and route to Rigby first. Rigby defines the pattern, writes the skill or convention doc, and Master executes against it.
recurrence_check: First logged instance of this specific routing failure for rmapi/reMarkable delivery.
